units.name: plugin and marketplace manifest
units.purpose: so Claude Code can install ABBD's skills from this repository as a marketplace plugin
units.responsibility: Declares the abbd marketplace, points it at ./plugins/abbd, and names the plugin's version and its requirements (pstack 0.15.36 and the abbd CLI on PATH).

units.name: project.yaml
units.purpose: so sync can rerun the project's own extraction script without being told how each time
units.responsibility: Holds the argv of the extraction script that setup recorded and sync runs from the repository root.

units.name: blueprint files
units.purpose: lets a human read the topology in a browser and tools read it without the CLI
units.responsibility: fixes the rendered files, the pages (index.html, one <ID>.html per unit on the overview that holds units or has a focus view, one page per flow, stack and table, contracts.html and units.html) and graph.json, and graph.json's shape: units, live edges, each module's inside without its drawing, and the figures. No file holds a value of the sync that rendered it; the state records which inputs it was rendered from

units.name: extraction JSON
units.purpose: so the project script, the swarm supplement and abbd agree on one format for units and relations
units.responsibility: The JSON shape the extraction script prints and the supplement repeats: units with key, kind, name, anchors or evidence, optional signature, digest and parent, and relations with from, to, kind, via and evidence, with unknown fields rejected.

units.name: sync state
units.purpose: so ABBD knows what tree and revision the stored units were synced from and which ID numbers were ever used
units.responsibility: Records the sync watermark: the revision first synced, the working-tree snapshot fingerprint, the inputs hash the blueprint was rendered from, and the per-kind high-water mark of minted IDs.

units.name: module understanding
units.purpose: so a reader's prose about a module sits beside its drawing and is flagged when the module's code moves on
units.responsibility: Stores one Markdown file per module with its unit ID, INFERRED origin and the module digest at writing time in frontmatter, and the Overview and Key Concepts text as body.

units.name: unit files
units.purpose: so the design units are reviewable Markdown that is the single source every other view derives from
units.responsibility: Defines one file per unit at architecture/ or features/ ID.md, YAML frontmatter with each fact's value and origin, a generated title and anchor list, and a human Notes section kept across rewrites.

units.name: /abbd
units.purpose: so an assistant consults and keeps current the repository's blueprint around every code change instead of grepping blind
units.responsibility: Tells the assistant to read the blueprint and ask explain, path and impact before work, record couplings, units and human-stated facts with their origin, and run sync and put the diff in the PR after work.

units.name: /abbd-setup
units.purpose: so a repository without .abbd gets its first topology baseline with no human alignment step
units.responsibility: Drives the one-time setup: a pstack swarm reads the code, a deterministic extraction script plus a supplement of readers' findings feed abbd setup, how's text is stored per module, and abbd install writes the CLAUDE.md block.

units.name: abbd exit codes
units.purpose: so scripts and CI tell a usage mistake from a failed command from success
units.responsibility: Fixes the process contract: exit 0 on success, 1 when a command fails, 64 when the command line does not parse, with the usage printed on stderr.

units.name: abbd diff
units.purpose: so a PR shows its topology change and CI can label a change that crosses module boundaries
units.responsibility: Prints the topology difference from a base revision as text or --json, and with --check exits 1 on a boundary change.

units.name: abbd evidence
units.purpose: so a reader sees which quoted evidence still holds in the working tree
units.responsibility: Prints live or dead, with location, for every quote of every unit and relation, and the totals, without writing.

units.name: abbd explain
units.purpose: so an assistant reads one unit's place in the architecture before it greps
units.responsibility: Prints a unit, found by ID or name, with its facts, inside units, contracts, neighbours, inferred couplings and how's text.

units.name: abbd impact
units.purpose: so an agent knows what a change reaches before it starts
units.responsibility: Prints the direct and far tiers a change to comma-separated unit IDs reaches, with why each is reached.

units.name: abbd install
units.purpose: so every assistant session asks the blueprint before grepping and leaves the topology current
units.responsibility: Writes or replaces the marked abbd block in the root CLAUDE.md and keeps everything else in that file.

units.name: abbd path
units.purpose: so a reader sees how two units are connected and how certain that connection is
units.responsibility: Prints the shortest hop path between two units and the weakest origin along it.

units.name: abbd record fact
units.purpose: so what a human said about a unit's why is kept with where they said it
units.responsibility: Records ID.purpose or ID.responsibility as USER_STATED with --value and --source.

units.name: abbd record relation
units.purpose: so a reader's or a human's coupling enters the state with its origin
units.responsibility: Records FROM KIND TO as INFERRED with --via and live --evidence, or USER_STATED with --source, never over an EXTRACTED relation.

units.name: abbd record unit
units.purpose: so a unit the script cannot see enters the state, anchored on its quoted code
units.responsibility: Records a KIND NAME unit as INFERRED with live --evidence, an optional module --parent and --responsibility, refusing a duplicate on the same code.

units.name: abbd setup
units.purpose: so a repository gets its first state from a proven-deterministic script plus the readers' supplement
units.responsibility: Registers the extraction argv after --, runs it three times to prove it deterministic, folds in --supplement, replaces earlier guesses and syncs.

units.name: abbd status
units.purpose: so anyone sees at once whether state and blueprint are current
units.responsibility: Prints the freshness of the state against the tree and of the blueprint against the state, with unit, relation and understanding counts.

units.name: abbd sync
units.purpose: so the stored topology follows the working tree after a code change
units.responsibility: Reruns the registered script, reconciles IDs across renames, checks every quote, writes the state and renders the blueprint.

units.name: abbd understand
units.purpose: so pstack how's text about a module is shown beside its drawing and flagged when the code moves on
units.responsibility: Stores a top-level module's Overview and Key Concepts from a file or stdin, stamped with the module's code digest.

units.name: relation key
units.purpose: so a relation can be named on the command line and as a map key without characters a shell treats specially
units.responsibility: The FROM.kind.TO text form of a relation, such as MOD-0001.depends_on.MOD-0002, that Edge.String prints and ParseEdge reads back, checking both IDs and the relation kind.

units.name: supplement fold
units.purpose: so a reader adds intent and couplings but never replaces what the script read from code
units.responsibility: Copies supplement purpose and responsibility onto the matched script unit as INFERRED, refuses an evidence unit that would merge into a script unit, skips couplings the script already extracted, and refuses a reader coupling with no evidence.

evidence.quote: a reader's coupling rests on the code it quotes

units.name: anchor matching
units.purpose: so a supplement entry describes exactly one script unit and an ambiguous one is refused rather than guessed
units.responsibility: Picks the script unit of the same kind sharing the most anchors with a supplement unit, and fails when none shares one or two share the same count.

evidence.quote: its anchors match more than one %s equally

units.name: reader-only unit
units.purpose: so a unit only a reader vouches for is marked as a guess and carries no code facts it did not read
units.responsibility: Builds a unit the script cannot see from a supplement entry: name made INFERRED, signature, digest and parent cleared, key replaced by its supplement position.

units.name: argv parsing and dispatch
units.purpose: so every verb shares one parser, one exit-code policy and one publish-after-write rule
units.responsibility: Owns the command table walk: two-word verbs, the setup-only -- argv split, flags interspersed with positionals, the positional count check, and calling publish after a writing verb.

units.name: CLAUDE.md abbd block
units.purpose: so install can replace its own block on a rerun and leave the rest of CLAUDE.md alone
units.responsibility: Defines the block text between <!-- abbd:begin --> and <!-- abbd:end -->, and the rule that a marker counts only alone on its line and outside fenced code, preserving the file's line endings.

units.name: blueprint publish
units.purpose: so the blueprint on disk always matches the state after a writing command
units.responsibility: Owns loading the screen input with the current tree snapshot, writing every blueprint file in one SaveBlueprint call, which removes the pages no render holds, then recording in the state which inputs they were rendered from.

units.name: query commands
units.purpose: so explain, path and impact answer architecture questions from the state without writing
units.responsibility: Owns resolving a unit by ID, exact name or near name, and printing topology's explain, path and impact results with names, origins and how's CURRENT or STALE text.

units.name: review commands
units.purpose: so a PR and its reviewer see what changed and whether the record still holds, without writing
units.responsibility: Owns diff against the units committed at a base revision with the --check boundary failure, the evidence live/dead report, and the status freshness and counts.

units.name: setup determinism proof and supplement fold

units.responsibility: Owns the three-run determinism proof (the third with reseeded PYTHONHASHSEED and PERL_HASH_SEED), reading the supplement relative to the root, and folding it over the script output before syncing with guesses replaced.

units.name: sync pipeline
units.purpose: so the state always rests on the deterministic extraction alone

units.name: liveness and line moves

units.name: whitespace-free file index
units.purpose: so each file is read once and a match in the stripped text maps back to real line numbers

units.name: untrusted-output gate
units.purpose: so malformed or overreaching extraction output fails loudly instead of entering the state
units.responsibility: Decodes with unknown fields refused, requires a valid kind, a name and at least one anchor, allows a signature only on contracts, and appends each evidence item as an anchor so a reader's unit is identified by the code it cites.

units.name: key and parent checks
units.purpose: so the units and relations of one run form a well-formed graph before identity matching sees them
units.responsibility: Refuses duplicate keys, a parent that is not another module, parent cycles, relations naming missing keys or a unit itself, and relation kinds that cannot join the two unit kinds.

units.purpose: so no extraction can claim a purpose or responsibility as a code fact or as a human's word

units.name: anchor path normalization
units.purpose: so anchors and evidence paths compare equal to the paths git reports on every platform
units.responsibility: Turns backslashes into forward slashes, cleans the path, and refuses empty, absolute or root-escaping paths.

evidence.quote: // Anchors must compare equal to the forward-slash, root-relative paths git reports.

units.name: default-branch base search
units.purpose: so diff finds a base to compare with in a local clone and in a bare CI checkout alike
units.responsibility: Tries origin's HEAD, the upstream, origin/main, origin/master, main and master in that order and returns the first merge base with HEAD.

units.name: rename detection
units.purpose: so a moved file keeps its units' IDs instead of looking like a delete and an add
units.responsibility: Diffs two snapshot trees with unlimited rename detection, parses the NUL-separated name-status output into old-to-new paths, and reports ok=false when the old tree was garbage collected.

units.name: working-tree snapshot
units.purpose: so a sync can fingerprint the working tree, untracked files included, without disturbing the user's index
units.responsibility: Stages the whole tree minus an excluded path into a throwaway GIT_INDEX_FILE and returns the written tree ID, or empty outside a repository.

units.name: human-held unit retention
units.purpose: so a reader-found unit a human spoke about is not marked absent when a new supplement stops reporting it
units.responsibility: Computes, to a fixed point, the semantic units that carry a USER_STATED fact or relation or are pointed at by a stated relation from a unit that stays, and keeps them present as Stated.

units.name: anchor takeover matching
units.purpose: so an extracted unit inherits a stored ID only when the code evidently is the same unit, regardless of input order
units.responsibility: Pairs extracted and stored units of the same kind that share two or more anchors or an identical anchor set, assigning globally best match first (identical, then larger overlap, then smaller difference).

units.name: fact and relation ownership
units.purpose: so a rerun of the script or of setup never overwrites what a human stated
units.responsibility: On a match the extraction replaces anchors, signature, digest and EXTRACTED names and relations; INFERRED guesses are replaced only by a setup (ReplaceGuesses); USER_STATED facts and relations always survive.

units.name: evidence citation
units.purpose: so a cited excerpt has one shape whether it comes from the supplement or the command line
units.responsibility: An evidence item is a path, optional lines such as 120 or 120-134, optional symbol and a verbatim quote, written PATH:LINES:QUOTE on the command line, and may not cite .abbd or .git files.

units.name: unit ID format
units.purpose: so a unit keeps one stable, typed name across syncs, commands and files
units.responsibility: IDs are a kind prefix, a dash and at least four digits, such as MOD-0001; FormatID writes them and ParseID reads the kind back.

units.name: fact origins
units.purpose: so everyone can tell a code fact from a reader's guess from a human's word
units.responsibility: Defines the EXTRACTED, INFERRED and USER_STATED origins and enforces that a why-field is never EXTRACTED and that exactly the USER_STATED facts carry a source.

units.name: relation grammar
units.purpose: so every relation, extracted, read or stated, has a meaning ABBD can draw

units.purpose: tells the human whether what they read can be trusted
units.responsibility: compares the working-tree snapshot with the synced fingerprint (state CURRENT, STALE or UNKNOWN) and the inputs hash the state says the blueprint was rendered from with the inputs hash now (blueprint freshness), and reads a merged state as STALE

units.name: module inside
units.purpose: shows what inside a module meets each of its contracts and the other modules
units.responsibility: draws a module's child units inside a frame whose ports are its contracts and the other modules it touches without one, marks ports no inside unit is wired to as unwired, and lists the inferred couplings touching the module with their quotes

units.name: overview plan

units.responsibility: picks the top-level units and only extracted or stated live relations between them, assigns each contract its providers and users, and draws contract wires between chips and bypass wires for module dependencies no contract covers

units.name: page template
units.purpose: turns the model into the pages a human opens
units.responsibility: holds the embedded Korean HTML template, one named template per kind of page, its helper functions and the Korean labels for kinds and origin badges, and the stylesheet every page inlines, which styles each wire kind and port class the model emits

units.name: understanding text
units.purpose: shows pstack how's text for a module without trusting any markup in it
units.responsibility: splits a module's stored text into heading, list-item and paragraph blocks with code and bold spans, and marks it STALE when the module's code digest moved since the text was written

units.name: merge candidates file
units.purpose: so a leftover anchor overlap the matcher did not resolve waits in .abbd for a human instead of being merged silently
units.responsibility: Persists .abbd/candidates.yaml as a list of new, existing and shared-anchor entries, written empty rather than absent, and pruned to live IDs on each sync.

units.name: store staleness hashes
units.purpose: so derived views can tell cheaply whether what they rendered still matches the stored files
units.responsibility: Hashes sorted file sets as relative path, length and bytes: InputsHash over every .abbd file except the blueprint and state.yaml, which the state records as the inputs the blueprint was rendered from.

units.name: ID high-water minting
units.purpose: so an ID number, once given out, is never handed to another unit even after its unit is deleted
units.responsibility: Mints the next ID of a kind for a hand-recorded unit by bumping the per-kind high-water in state.yaml and saving it.

units.name: units at a revision
units.purpose: so a diff can compare today's units with those committed at a base revision
units.responsibility: Reads and parses the committed unit files under .abbd/architecture and .abbd/features at a revision through git, treating a revision without .abbd as having no units.

units.name: module code digest

units.name: unit notes section

units.purpose: so one unit can be read at a glance with its neighbours

units.name: abbd CLI
units.purpose: so a human or an assistant drives extraction, evidence, IDs, storage and rendering from one command line
units.responsibility: Owns the abbd command line: parsing argv against the command table, running each verb over the store, and rendering the blueprint after every verb that writes.

units.name: internal/evidence

units.name: internal/extract
units.purpose: so untrusted script or model output becomes typed units only after it passes strict checks
units.responsibility: Decodes the extraction JSON with unknown fields refused, validates kinds, names, anchor paths, signatures, parents and relation kinds, and turns evidence into anchors so a reader's unit has a stable identity.

units.name: internal/identity
